description: This file contains shell script tests for Git checkout command behavior, including branch switching, reflog references, detached HEAD state, and rebase scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided commands if successful.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp_symbolic_HEAD_ref
methods.description: Compares the symbolic ref of HEAD with the expected branch name.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two Git object hashes or references.
